scope: Requested read-only check of all six released elections k10–k15 against official opening-date membership; no other election data changed.
provenance: Project reviewed extraction from official Knesset OData responses, not a byte-for-byte official publication. Exact selected names, record identifiers, service/faction dates, request URLs, bytes and original response hashes retained. K9 Ratz original two-record response is retained separately.

method.pagination: Follow every odata.nextLink and append &$format=json; the service omits the format in next links. No $top truncation.
method.membership: PositionID43 (male MK) or61 (female MK); StartDate <= first session and FinishDate > first session (or null). PositionID54 provides affiliation on that same date.
method.datasetSelection: scenarioFromDataset and electedOf with officialSeats, honoring notSeated (Arens k13, Namir k14, Deri and Begin k15). Never simply take registered ranks <= seat count.
method.comparison: Surname + given name, strip whitespace/punctuation only. No fuzzy matches promoted. Raw unmatched names may be aliases, middle names, historical renaming, transcription errors, or actual membership differences; they are not certified as different people.
method.reproduction: Fetch each recorded OData request; interpret position definitions; apply the recorded opening-date filter; compare electedOf(scenarioFromDataset(dataset)) by normalized names. Official extracted rows retained here allow the comparison without scratch or network.

findings: k10: substantive unmatched dataset names include בן-אהרן אברהם and ורד תמר; official unmatched opening members include כץ-עוז אברהם (PersonID2413) and ותד מחמד (2328). Other apparent transcription issues include דרורי שרה, וירג׳מן דרור, רבי צבי, יגורי יצחק, חריש משה, חרש מיכאל, נעים עבד. Do not auto-correct without gazette reinspection.
k11: apparent transcription differences include שפירא אליהו versus official שפייזר אליהו (2659), רן נחמן versus רז נחמן (2606), and ששי וידאן versus עטשי זיידאן (2523).
k12: dataset seats רייסר מיכאל; official opening membership has גולדברג יוסף (2237). Requires review of timing/corrections; no replacement applied.
k13: dataset אור אריה versus official אור אורי (2132). Name discrepancy retained, no change.
k14: dataset ריבלין חיים and ליבני יהודה versus official דיין חיים (2276) and לנקרי יהודה (2444). No change.

k15: all 19 raw differences appear compatible with abbreviated names/aliases or historical spelling; identity equivalence is not certified from string similarity. No unexplained extra/missing person asserted.
